metadata.title: NutriBook - Find a nutritionist
metadata.description: Search nutritionists by name, service, and location, and request an appointment.

siteHeader.forProfessionals: Are you a nutrition professional? Get to know our software

search.queryPlaceholder: Search for a nutritionist or service
search.locationDenied: Allow location access in your browser, or type a city.
search.locationUnavailable: We couldn't find your location. Try again or type a city.
search.nearestCityUnavailable: We couldn't look up the nearest city. Try again or type a city.
search.heading: {count, plural, one {# nutritionist} other {# nutritionists}} in {city}
search.unknownLocationDescription: Showing nutritionists in {city} instead. Pick a city from the location suggestions.
search.noMatch: Nobody in {city} matches “{query}”. Try another name or service.
search.noneInCity: There are no nutritionists in {city} yet. Try a nearby city.
search.unavailableDescription: We couldn't reach the nutritionist directory. <retry>Try again</retry>.

appointment.title: Schedule an appointment
appointment.description: With {name}, {title, select, Dietitian {dietitian} other {nutritionist}} in {city}. They will confirm your request by email.
appointment.name: Your name
appointment.pickDay: Pick a day to see available times.
appointment.unavailable: We could not send your request. Try again in a moment.
